description:
fz-gk4 removed the only reader of the lazy-continuation descriptor's spec-id slot: `fz_materialize_cont` used to pass it to `alloc_closure_slots` as a target id the closure header discarded. `build_lazy_cont_descriptor` (src/compiler2/native_codegen/closure.rs) no longer writes it, and `LAZY_CONT_SID_OFF` is gone from runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs; +8 is now a documented hole inside a 32-byte header whose live fields are code pointer (+0) and capture count (+16).

The descriptor is a stack slot, so the waste is per mid-flight-yield frame rather than heap-resident, which is why this is not urgent.

Acceptance: either compact the header (watch the 16-byte alignment `LAZY_CONT_RAW_OFF = 32` currently guarantees) or put a live field in the hole. Either way the reserved-hole comments in both files go away.

comments.text: SUPERSEDED by fz-kdt.8 under the fz-kdt re-baseline epic. Re-verified at main 417c5b0b5: both reserved-hole comments are still live (closure.rs:222, ir_runtime.rs:1833), so the ticket is valid as written. Moved unchanged apart from the verification line. Work continues in fz-kdt.8.

title: Lazy cont descriptor carries a reserved 8-byte hole at +8
